According to police reports, while the first officer completed paperwork at the jail,
the teen continued making inappropriate remarks toward him and repeatedly claimed he appeared aroused by the arrest.
She eventually extended her foot and made an inappropriate contact with the officer's pelvic area in front of jail staff,
resulting in yet another charge against her.
Eventually, the 17-year-old was charged with felony threat to a law enforcement officer,
misdemeanor, fourth-degree sex assault, disorderly conduct, and resisting an officer.
She was also charged with operating while intoxicated, first offense, and later released on a $10,000 signature bond.
Eventually, she was found guilty of threats to an officer, fourth-degree assault, and operating while intoxicated.
Remaining charges were dismissed.
Ultimately, her sentence was withheld, and she was placed on 30 months of probation.
If she successfully completes the terms of her probation, the case will be eligible for expungement, effectively removing it from her record.

event_summary.short: A 17-year-old girl who stole her boyfriend's car was stopped by Eau Claire police for driving without headlights and suspected DUI. She became verbally abusive, threatened officers, and later committed sexual assault by touching an officer's pelvic area. She was arrested and ultimately convicted on multiple charges.
